origin: CondadosAI independent reproduction of EyeDentify/PupilSense; derived per-person model summaries
license: Third-party original EyeDentify data/checkpoints CC BY-NC 4.0; CondadosAI analysis code Apache-2.0. No original eye images/weights redistributed.
limitations: Third-party derived per-participant aggregates; original images and checkpoint not rerun.
Checkpoint training split undocumented; possible in-sample overlap.
Correlations pooled across multiple three-second stimulus trials, not continuous five-second waveforms.
No native RGB/tracker timestamp or clock uncertainty; no lag, NRMSE, glasses, lighting or device holdout.
Thresholds 0.7 and amplitude 0.75-1.25 are exploratory diagnostics, not Lucent frozen human gates.
